purpose: Registry of decision-support signals for Romanian RTA market intelligence. Every source is labelled by what it measures and must never be promoted to verified sales unless it is direct sales evidence.

sources.label: Vânzări / bestseller retailer
sources.truthRule: Primary commercial evidence. Exact units only when explicitly exposed; otherwise ranking/bestseller stays a ranking signal.

sources.label: Căutări Google România
sources.truthRule: Measures search demand, not sales. Use Romania geo targeting and exact product/brand aliases; preserve monthly series and average monthly searches.

sources.label: Google Trends România
sources.truthRule: Relative search interest only; never convert Trends index into absolute search volume or sales.

sources.label: Interes în ghid-rta.ro
sources.truthRule: Anonymous first-party intent. Aggregate by canonical product/brand/category; do not expose raw user-level histories.

sources.label: Reddit vaping
sources.truthRule: Community interest and sentiment, not Romanian sales. Respect authorized API access, rate limits and subreddit/platform rules.

sources.label: Comunități Facebook vaping România
sources.truthRule: Do not bypass Meta access restrictions. Only public indexable content or explicitly authorized/exported sources may be used.

sources.label: Forumuri publice vaping
sources.truthRule: Use only publicly accessible pages and respect robots/terms. Measures discussion interest, not sales.

sources.label: YouTube emergent
sources.truthRule: Current external lead indicator only; old lifetime views cannot create an emerging signal.

sources.label: Radar producători
sources.truthRule: Launch radar, not demand proof. Can corroborate but cannot create a Romanian sales recommendation by itself.

harmonization.managementRule: External and intent signals may strengthen or weaken confidence and reveal white-space, but a BUY/EXPAND recommendation must retain Romanian commercial evidence unless explicitly labelled as a controlled test.
harmonization.missingSourceRule: Unavailable optional sources reduce signal coverage/confidence but never fail the core Market pipeline or create partial UI output.
